primary_question: Does longitudinal project behavior provide meaningful incremental predictive value over static/current CUF-style attributes?
executive_answer: No across both regimes for overall PR-AUC / Average Precision. In Legacy, static/CUF-style attributes alone achieve 0.4131 AP (89.55% of feature importance), and adding 11 longitudinal features yields a statistically neutral delta of -0.0060 AP (95% CI [-0.0189, 0.0073], spanning zero), while offering a targeted recall improvement at tau=0.5 (+0.0336). In Modern, static attributes provide 0.7587 AP (84.06% of importance), and adding longitudinal features significantly degrades performance (-0.0496 AP, strictly negative 95% CI) due to truncated tenure across the July 2025 boundary.

LEGACY.conclusion: Static/CUF features provide the primary predictive baseline (0.4131 AP). Adding longitudinal features does not provide a statistically significant overall AP improvement (delta CI spans zero), though it modestly improves thresholded recall (+3.36 percentage points at tau=0.5).

MODERN.contract_status: Longitudinal features are structurally excluded from the locked Modern production model contract.
MODERN.conclusion: Static/CUF-style attributes account for virtually all predictive signal in Modern (0.7587 AP). Adding longitudinal features degrades performance (-0.0496 AP) due to short post-July-2025 tenure depth.

operational_recommendation.legacy_serving: CatBoost with full 36 features (static + longitudinal) for historical pre-2025-07 queries.
operational_recommendation.modern_serving: Logistic Regression with 25 static features for active 2025-07+ monitoring.
operational_recommendation.future_evolution_trigger: Re-evaluate longitudinal feature inclusion for Modern only after at least 24 months of continuous post-redesign observations accumulate (earliest 2027-07).
